title: Small local models on the 8 GB Mac mini
scope: Comparison of the Ollama models installed on this machine for high-risk, low-cognitive enterprise tasks: cost, security, local data, latency. Companion page: small-models.html

host.notes: Unified memory. 4B-class models at Q4_K_M run acceptably only at short context; 1.7-3B models are the practical daily band.

benchmark.method: ollama /api/generate, stream=false, temperature 0.1, num_predict 160, num_ctx 8192, Q4_K_M (F16 for the embedder)
benchmark.note: DeepSeek-R1 1.5B always emits reasoning tokens; its token/s includes them. qwen3:4b at 32K context was measured unusable (~1 tok/s) earlier; at 8K it reaches 19.5 tok/s. Context budget dominates latency on this machine.

models.corpus: ~36T tokens across the Qwen3 dense series; multilingual, code-heavy
models.goal: Smallest practical Qwen3 tier for on-device and edge; hybrid thinking/quick modes; tool calling
models.enterprise_fit: Local-data tier: extraction, classification, routing, summarisation under guardrails; fastest useful model here

models.corpus: ~36T tokens across the Qwen3 dense series; multilingual, code-heavy
models.goal: Strongest Qwen3 on-device tier; hybrid thinking; agentic tool use

measured.note: ~1 tok/s at 32K context on this machine

models.enterprise_fit: Server or workstation tier rather than this Mac mini at long context; grounded extraction and drafting where a 1.7-3B model underperforms

models.goal: General small instruct model with tool calling; fine-tune-friendly base
models.enterprise_fit: Fine for local experiments; commercial product use is restricted by license (research licence, see below)

models.corpus: ~5.5T tokens, code-heavy mix on the Qwen2.5 base
models.goal: Local code completion (FIM insert capability) and chat on low-memory machines
models.enterprise_fit: Dev-tooling tier: autocomplete and code review assistants inside secure dev environments
models.license_note: Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE per HF LICENSE file; verify terms before commercial deployment

models.corpus: ~9T tokens per Meta for the 1B/3B pair; pruned and distilled from Llama 3.1 8B
models.goal: Meta's mobile and edge tier: summarisation, rewriting, instruction following, on-device assistants; 8 languages incl. Hindi
models.enterprise_fit: Local-data tier with the widest vendor ecosystem (day-one Qualcomm, MediaTek, Arm, ExecuTorch); on-prem assistants
models.license_note: Llama 3.2 Community License; monthly active users over 700M need Meta approval

models.corpus: Distilled on ~800K reasoning samples from R1-671B atop the Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B base
models.goal: Bring chain-of-thought reasoning to small, local models: math, logic, single-turn code

measured.note: Token/s includes reasoning tokens; useful output per second is lower

models.enterprise_fit: Component model: local reasoning checks, numeric verification, low-risk logic steps inside pipelines

models.corpus: ~2.4B tokens, contrastive Matryoshka training (per Nomic technical report)
models.goal: Local retrieval embeddings (768-dim) for RAG and knowledge-bundle search
models.enterprise_fit: Supporting model: the retrieval half of any grounded small-model setup on local data

models.family: Gemma 4 E4B (Google DeepMind), Apache 2.0, Apr 2026; E4B = effective-4B dense design, 8B total with embeddings (per-layer embeddings + vision/audio encoders)
models.context: 131072 build and native 128K design; hybrid 512-token sliding + global attention, shared KV in last 18 layers, p-RoPE
models.quantization: Q4_K_M, 9.6 GB on disk (full multimodal bundle: text + image + audio input)
models.corpus: Google-internal web/code/image/audio mix, cutoff Jan 2025, 140+ languages; token budget not published (tech report arXiv 2607.02770)
models.goal: Google's on-device tier: multimodal understanding, configurable thinking mode, native function calling and JSON, agentic workflows at the edge

measured.note: warm steady state, 11-15 gen tok/s across five runs, deterministic output; cold first load 8.0 gen / 32.5 prompt tok/s, ~39 s wall (9.6 GB bundle exceeds comfortable resident RAM on 8 GB)

models.enterprise_fit: On-device class (effective 4B): the only installed model that takes image/audio input and the strongest on paper of the four chat families; on this Mac prefer Google's QAT / mobile builds (E4B ~3.65 GB in LiteRT-LM) over the 9.6 GB Q4 bundle

deployments.company_or_product: Qualcomm AI Hub on-device packs (Samsung Galaxy S25 family listed as supported target devices, not a confirmed Samsung ship)
deployments.task: On-device assistant and agent workloads on Snapdragon 8 Elite / X Elite PCs and Dragonwing automotive / industrial targets
deployments.approach: Modified: INT4 w4a16 quantisation to ~2.3 GB, exported to the Genie/GenieX NPU runtimes; LoRA fine-tuning supported via QAIRT
deployments.source: Qualcomm AI Hub model cards and release notes

deployments.company_or_product: Meta edge ecosystem (Qualcomm, MediaTek, Arm, ExecuTorch)

deployments.approach: Mostly direct or vendor-quantised: Meta ships quantised variants (up to ~4x faster, ~56% smaller, ~41% less memory vs BF16); products integrate them via on-device runtimes

deployments.approach: Direct: unmodified GGUF weights served by Ollama; the 3B tier is the low-memory recommendation, larger tiers preferred when hardware allows

deployments.task: General chat, extraction; fine-tuned for domain Q&A in several verticals
deployments.approach: Both: hosted as-is on-demand, or modified via LoRA fine-tunes for verticals

deployments.company_or_product: Local stacks (LM Studio, Jan, Open WebUI presets with Ollama)
deployments.task: Local reasoning: math, logic, code explanation
deployments.approach: Direct; no flagship named enterprise product surfaced in this review, it is used as a component

deployments.task: Dialogue and content generation on Snapdragon 8 Elite / X Elite, Dragonwing, Arduino VENTUNO Q; 4096-token context; on-device accuracy 73% vs 81.2% reference
deployments.approach: Direct: original weights with QAIRT W4A16 / q4_0w4a16 quantization, no fine-tuning
deployments.source: Qualcomm AI Hub model page; GenieX (NexaAI) README

deployments.company_or_product: Gemini Nano 4 'Full' on Android (AICore Developer Preview)
deployments.task: On-device assistant with highest-quality answers; Nano 4 'Fast' variant is E2B-based and ~3x faster; agentic prototyping via AICore
deployments.approach: Direct-open foundation: Gemma 4 weights are Apache 2.0; Nano 4 ships as Google's product layer on top; code written for Gemma 4 runs on Nano 4 devices
deployments.source: 9to5Google (2 Apr 2026); Android AICore Developer Preview announcement

deployments.company_or_product: Google AI Edge: LiteRT-LM and AI Edge Gallery

deployments.task: Local serving of official QAT checkpoints (Q4_0 and mobile quantization formats); GenieX runs the QAT GGUF on Snapdragon NPU/GPU/CPU
deployments.approach: Direct official QAT weights, no fine-tuning
deployments.source: Google QAT release blog (Jun 2026); GenieX (NexaAI) README
